passages.text:
Marks scored by 20 students in a test
Mark        2    3    4    5    6
Frequency   3    5    6    4    2

questions.q: If log₂ x + log₂ (x − 2) = 3, the value of x is
questions.explanation: log₂[x(x − 2)] = 3 ⇒ x² − 2x = 8 ⇒ (x − 4)(x + 2) = 0 ⇒ x = 4 (x must be positive and greater than 2).

questions.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by (3 + √2): denominator = 9 − 2 = 7.

questions.explanation: Areas are in the ratio of squares of sides: 4 : 25 ⇒ 12 × 25/4 = 75 cm².

questions.explanation: Similar triangles: shadow/height = 20/5 = 4 ⇒ man's shadow = 1.8 × 4 = 7.2 m.
